meta.title: Can Miró: villa with private pool in Jávea (Xàbia), Costa Blanca
meta.description: A sun-filled 4-bedroom villa with a private pool in La Lluca, Jávea. Sunny terraces, two kitchens and four outdoor lounges on Spain's Costa Blanca.

hero.title: Can Miró
hero.subtitle: A sun-washed villa with a private heated pool, tucked into the Lluca hills yet minutes from Jávea's beaches and old town.

intro.title: Your unhurried place in the Mediterranean sun
intro.body: Tucked into the green hillside of La Lluca, Can Miró is a spacious family villa built for slow mornings and long, warm evenings. Wake to birdsong, swim before breakfast, and drift between four outdoor lounges as the light moves across the day. The beaches of the Arenal and the cobbled old town of Jávea are both a short drive away.

rates.title: Prices & terms
rates.subtitle: Can Miró is let in July and August, with a minimum stay of 7 nights. Below are the weekly rates, the extra costs and our terms.
rates.perNightNote: The rate for a single night is
rates.perNightExtra: The calendar below counts per night. We confirm the weekly rate above when you enquire.
rates.extrasNote: The required costs are paid when you book. The late-arrival surcharge and the high chair are settled on arrival.

extras.linen: Bed linen and towels (beach towel included)

rates.payment: After booking you pay a deposit of 30% of the rental price. The balance is due on the date given in your booking confirmation. If you book within 60 days of arrival, you pay the full amount in one go at the time of booking.
rates.cancellation60plus: Cancel more than 60 days before arrival and you pay 30% of the rental price, that is the deposit.
rates.cancellation60minus: Cancel 60 days or less before arrival and the full rental price is due.
rates.cancellationNoShow: If you do not arrive, or leave earlier than planned, the full rental price remains due.
rates.cancellationForce: If we have to cancel through circumstances beyond our control, everything you have paid is refunded.
rates.cancellationTip: Cancellations are always made in writing. We recommend taking out cancellation insurance.
rates.depositNote: The damage deposit comes back to you within 14 days of departure, once the villa has been checked.

items.r1: The photos don't do it justice. The pool and terraces were the heart of our week, we barely wanted to leave. Spotless, calm and beautifully kept.
items.r2: Perfect for our family of six. Two kitchens made everything easy, the kids lived at the table-tennis table, and the beach was a five-minute drive. We're already rebooking.
items.r3: A truly relaxing week. Comfortable, quiet, and every outdoor corner catches the sun at a different time of day. Wonderful hosts, too.

season.a: We let Can Miró in July and August, with a minimum stay of 7 nights. Have other dates in mind? Do ask, and we will see what is possible.

apartment.q: What is the separate apartment downstairs?
apartment.a: The lower floor holds a complete apartment with its own entrance, bedroom, bathroom and kitchen. Ideal if you travel as two families, or with grandparents or older children along: on holiday together, and still a place of your own.

checkin.q: What are the check-in and check-out times?
checkin.a: Check-in is between 16:00 and 20:00, check-out by 10:00. Arriving after 20:00 carries a € 50 surcharge, paid on site. Let us know and we will make sure someone is there for you.

deposit.a: Yes, a damage deposit of € 750 per stay, paid when you book. It comes back to you within 14 days of departure, once the villa has been checked.

cancellation.a: Cancel more than 60 days before arrival and you pay 30% of the rental price, that is the deposit. Within 60 days of arrival the full rental price is due. Cancellations are always made in writing, and we recommend taking out cancellation insurance.

cleaning.a: The final cleaning is € 350 per stay, paid when you book. Bed linen and towels, beach towel included, are € 30 per person. We are happy to arrange cleaning during your stay on request.

pool.q: Is the pool private and heated?
pool.a: Yes. The pool is private, for your party alone, and heated. It is 10.60 by 4.70 metres and slopes from 1.10 to 2.00 metres deep, so there is room for proper lengths.

kids.q: Is the villa suitable for children?
kids.a: Certainly. There is space to spare, a table tennis table and safe corners in the garden, and pool toys for the little ones. A travel cot and a high chair are available too, € 45 each per stay. Do note that children must always be supervised by an adult at the pool.

pets.a: Unfortunately pets are not allowed at the villa.

parking.a: Yes, there is a private driveway and parking on the property. A car is worth having to explore the area properly.

layout.title: Room by room
layout.subtitle: Four bedrooms and three bathrooms, spread across the villa and a self-contained apartment on the lower floor with its own entrance.

living.name: Living room
living.body: A light, characterful living room in Spanish style, with wooden beams across the ceiling and an open fireplace. The big, comfortable sofa is where you unwind after a day of sun and sea. The doors fold back onto the terrace, so inside and outside run into one another. Under the archway sits the dining area with a long wooden table, with room for everyone to pull up a chair.

kitchen.name: Kitchen
kitchen.body: A light, open kitchen with wooden cabinets and a fresh, modern feel. You cook on an electric hob with four zones, and there is a combination microwave, an extractor hood and plenty of cutlery and crockery. The doors open straight onto the terrace and the outdoor kitchen with its barbecue, so you cook inside, grill outside and then sit down together in the sun.

bedroom1.name: Bedroom 1
bedroom1.body: A generous bedroom with a double bed and a beautifully carved wooden headboard in Spanish style. The chest of drawers holds everything you have brought, and the window looks out over the green of the garden. The air conditioning keeps it cool even on the warmest summer nights.

bedroom2.name: Bedroom 2
bedroom2.body: A light bedroom with two single beds, ideal for children, friends or travelling companions. The crisp white furnishings and the colourful painting of the coast give the room a cheerful holiday feel. Each bed has its own bedside table and reading lamp.

bedroom3.name: Bedroom 3
bedroom3.body: A quiet bedroom on the garden side with two single beds, a wardrobe and air conditioning. A good room for children, or for anyone who likes an early night.

bathroom1.name: Bathroom 1
bathroom1.body: An en-suite bathroom with a shower, a bath, a washbasin and a toilet. After a day at the pool or on the beach you step straight from your room into the shower, or run a long bath in the evening.

bathroom2.name: Bathroom 2
bathroom2.body: A shared bathroom for bedrooms 2 and 3, with a shower, a washbasin and a toilet. Practical when you travel with children or friends: after a day of sun and swimming everyone freshens up here. A hairdryer is provided, so nobody is held up before an evening out.

bedroom4.name: Bedroom 4
bedroom4.body: The bedroom of the self-contained apartment, with a double bed. The apartment has its own entrance, bathroom and kitchen, so you have a place entirely of your own down here. Ideal for grandparents, older children, or friends who like a little privacy. On holiday together, and still at your own pace.

bathroom3.name: Bathroom 3
bathroom3.body: An en-suite bathroom off the apartment bedroom, with a shower, a washbasin and a toilet. Everything is to hand downstairs, in your own privacy. Worth knowing: there is also a separate outdoor toilet by the pool, behind the barbecue, so nobody walks through the house with wet feet.

pool.name: Pool and garden
pool.body: A private pool of 4.70 by 10.60 metres, sloping from 1.10 to 2.00 metres deep, set in the middle of a Mediterranean garden of more than 2,000 m² with palms, olive trees and cypresses. Long enough for proper lengths, and entirely your own. Sun loungers and parasols stand all around, and after a swim you rinse off under the outdoor shower. In the evening the pool is softly lit.

houseRules.title: How we like to keep things
houseRules.subtitle: Can Miró sits in a quiet residential area. A few simple agreements keep it a good place for you, for the neighbours and for the guests after you.

items.mainBooker: The lead guest is at least 28 and stays at the villa throughout.
items.events: Parties and events are not possible.
items.poolSupervision: Children in and around the pool are always supervised by an adult, so swimming stays safe for everyone.
items.maintenance: The pool and garden systems are operated by our maintenance people. They come by regularly, so please let them in.
items.leaveTidy: Please leave the villa tidy: washing-up done and put away, and everything back in its place.
items.report: Is something broken or not working? Tell us straight away and we will sort it out as quickly as we can.
